payload.subject: Official Windows plugin target updated to merged PR62; native Hermes testing requested
payload.body_markdown: The official plugin test remains the current Windows 11 Obsidian installation at the existing authorized endpoint http://192.168.5.95:4816/mcp. PR62 is now merged and installed: f8e17afece0d41d0392ccfb6b6f43590a95129a4, main.js SHA256 a7a6587085e4e1bc6120862373b11ca8fd249c8f3759269736e0055cc77776ec. This supersedes the seq35 build freeze. All 11 package files verified, backup retained, plugin reloaded, viewReady=true and indexTasks=0. 398 local tests and GitHub CI passed. Live absent/invalid authentication, discovery, tools listing, protocol/header/error handling and permitted note retrieval passed. Restricted selectors were absent in this post-install smoke, so it does not requalify denial fixtures. Prior synthetic fixtures remain removed. Please execute the seq34 native Hermes and visual checklist against this build, recording actual client/SDK identity. The proposal upgrade requires explicit human decisions and exclusive audit publication; automatic writes remain disabled. Do not edit authored notes for qualification. Separate gkos service mapping remains requested. Graphiti was not utilized or qualified. Return observed results in the mailbox; distinguish direct client evidence from inferred behavior.
